rules_text.english: Extreme low temperatures in the Winterlands make survival tough. Being cold for too long will result in death. Satisfying this need activates the {UI.Boost.Heat.WithIcon}, making it easier to satisfy every other need.
Villagers need <style=Input>{Concern.Heat.WithIcon}</style> in order to survive in the cold in the <style=Input>Winterlands</style>, otherwise they'll freeze to death.

There's no farming or foraging in the Winterlands.
You'll need to trap animals to get <style=Input>{ResourceCategory.Food.WithIcon}</style>.
